name: scenario-suite-p3-forward-b-fill-odd-ue
description: Protocol 13.23 supplement 7: odd-lot orders for the long legs of the retail 10M row (gap 0.0025, half tick under policy A, minimum commission NT$1); otherwise verbatim from scenario_suite_v1_p3b_fill_ue.json. Protocol 13.23 supplement 6: capital_basis unit_exposure (long-short book = 0.5 long + 0.5 short, capital scenarios are totals across both markets); otherwise verbatim from scenario_suite_v1_p3b_fill.json. Protocol 13.23 supplement 4 sensitivity (rule F: open fill with own impact, Y 0.7, f 10%); cost profiles from cost_profiles_supp4.json (retail 10M added); every other key equals scenario_suite_v1_p3b.json. Experiment protocol section 13.23 supplement 2: scenario_suite_v1_p3 with the report periods derived from the data end (the user's 2026-11-02 rule): P3 = the last complete calendar quarter plus the current partial quarter = [2026-07-01, 2026-10-23); P2 = the four quarters before it; P1 from 2023-01-02 to P2. Everything else (strategies, construction, execution layer, costs, benchmarks, bootstrap, selection) is byte-for-byte the frozen scenario_suite_v1_p3.json. Experiment protocol section 13.20: the P3 forward backtest of S1 / S2 (section 13.19 supplement 4 construction and execution layer, parameters fixed to the registered selection) and S-A (the weekly low-turnover long band of section 13.18 item 7, K x m selected once on TWSE / P1 / institution / fractional net Sharpe) on the extended walk-forward predictions of B0 F0 and B0 F2. Periods P1, P2 and P3; the decision union P1+P2 excludes P3, which is reported with point estimates and intervals only. Run with --chip-data-root <tw_chip_data>/data and one --label per predictions file (F0, F2).

splits.note: 1:4 split; the dataset's adjusted_close carries dividends only
